notes.title: Summoner's Gambit Playtest Update & gamescom 2025 Hands-On!
notes.content: [p][b]GAMESCOM 2025 LIVE DEMO[/b] [/p][p][i]Summoner's Gambit[/i] has descended upon gamescom 2025! [/p][p]🔥 Wager limbs and SANITY at [i]Hall 10.1, Stand A-042[/i] for exclusive hands-on trials![/p][p][/p][p][b]On-site rituals:[/b] [/p][p]🃏 Forge madness-driven decks to battle unspeakable horrors! [/p][p]⚡ Command legions born of primordial chaos! [/p][p]🌌 [i]"Trapped in the abyss? Shatter it with your strategy!"[/i] [/p][p]❓ [i]"What will your final move be?"[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]NEW PLAYTEST CALLING ALL STRATEGISTS![/b] [/p][p]Join the [i]Summoner's Gambit[/i] revamped Playtest on Steam NOW![/p][p][/p][p]A heartfelt thank you to all players who participated in the test! Based on your feedback, we’ve released a new Playtest version. Both new and existing players are sincerely invited to experience the updated content and actively submit your opinions—every piece of your feedback will directly help optimize the game![/p][p][/p][p]Currently, the game is still in development, and the test remains a small-scale closed one. Starting today, we will be releasing more test slots, which will be distributed randomly~[/p][p][/p][p]Once the version becomes more stable, we will launch an open demo on Steam. It is expected to take about a month to prepare for this, so please stay patient![/p][p][/p][p]🔹 Map Visual & Spawn Logic Overhaul[/p][p]-Full art style upgrade with enhanced terrain detailing and dynamic lighting[/p][p]-Intelligent resource spawn mechanics for refreshed exploration experience[/p][p]🔹 New Dynamic Event System[/p][p]-Randomly triggered exploration quests and resource competitions[/p][p]-Unique adventure guaranteed per playthrough[/p][p]🔹 Boss Encounter: Active Skill Injection[/p][p]-Players acquire random active skills during boss fights[/p][p]-Significantly deepened combat tactics[/p][p]🔹 Hotfixes & Optimizations[/p][p]-Smoothed difficulty scaling in specific levels[/p][p]-Stability improvements & performance optimizations[/p][p][/p][p][b]Final transmission:[/b][/p][p]⏳ WISHLIST ON STEAM!!![/p][p]⚔️ FACE THE OLD GODS[/p]
